answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where each agent provides a sonnet of unique keys to a verifier. The verifier acts as a wharf, docking agents to check their credentials against a registry to ensure uniqueness. While an honest node pays 1,000 units to register, a sybil farm faces a summit of costs for 1,000 fakes. We enforce evidence-triggered nullifiers; if duplication is caught, the identity is slashed, assuming no collusion.
